target_customer: Developers and data scientists who need vector embeddings of text and images
problem: Teams wanted word2vec-style embeddings for images and text without training or hosting models.
business_model: Usage-based API with a listed starting price of 49 dollars per month (third-party directory)

founders.name: Michael Lucy
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. No bio found.

founders.name: Jorge Silva
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. A Product Hunt profile exists. No bio found.

exit.reason: No shutdown or sale announcement found.

competitors.name: Clarifai
competitors.what: Computer vision API that also exposes image embeddings

technical_complexity.rationale: Serving pretrained models behind a scalable API. Model research was off the shelf, with hard parts in serving and cost.

defensibility.rationale: Cloud providers and open source models could offer the same embeddings, and switching costs were low.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large providers later shipped embedding endpoints, per general market coverage, though no source here dates it.

market_need_then: Product Hunt (2018-10-31) launched it as word2vec for anything, pitching vectors as input to clustering and other classic ML. Demand evidence beyond that was not found.

branding.domain_note: Used basilica.ai. As of 2026 that domain shows an unrelated developer compute product.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name with an architectural feel, but no press on the brand. The domain basilica.ai now hosts an unrelated compute product with the same name, which pollutes search.

outcome_analysis: Basilica launched on Product Hunt in October 2018 as an embeddings API and joined YC in Winter 2019. No funding, traction or shutdown reporting was found, and the YC page lists it inactive. The domain now serves an unrelated product, so ownership was likely transferred, but the cause of the stall is not public and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: No funding found; unknown is not zero. basilica.ai now hosts an unrelated compute product, so the website is not the original company. Clarifai source is a Wikipedia mirror stating 2018 events. Exit type unknown because YC says Inactive but no shutdown evidence.
